page.layout: One column of verse, centred stanzas with indented fourth lines; running head at top left, page number at top right.

p.i: Heu, heu, quantus adest militibus tuis Sudor! Quanta moues funera Ibericæ Genti. Quanta ferox Angla triremibus Pubes damna tuis feret!
Te mox fulmineo turbine glandium Quassabit, rutilis te petet ignibus, Incendétque simul lintea, remiges, Malos, transtráque navium,
Spumantéfque tuo sanguine gurgites Infecisse feri gestiet æquoris. Ridebit spolis auctus Americis, Auro ditior Indico.
Nequicquam æquoreos perdita tunc roga Diuos, supplicibus pietàve numina Votis sollicita. Non miseræ preces Duris mortibus eximent.
Nequicquam fugient hostibus impares, Et duris lacerae vulneribus rates. Nequicquam latebras Oceano petent. Exspes nil fuga proderit.
Si vicina petis littora Belgii, Parmensemque vocas præsidio Ducem, Te pellet Bataus miles acerbior, Hispani metuens ingi.
Est Anglis stabili fœdere Dania Iuncta, & quæ latitant tecta Trionibus Septenis profugos æquora negligunt, Tutúmque hospitium negant.

main_text.p: [?] Marked readings: "Exspes" and "Parmensemque" are read with the long s taken as s; the accents on "Incendétque", "Spumantéfque" and "Tutúmque" are as printed.

page.notes: Verse printed in italic throughout. Each stanza is four lines, the fourth indented. Long s read as s. Line breaks within stanzas are not kept in the paragraphs. Some letters, notably the ligatures for æ and the initial I/J forms, are uncertain at this scan resolution.
